categories.main_business_segments: Lizhong Sitong Light Alloys Group Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: functional intermediate alloy new materials, recycled casting aluminum alloy materials, and aluminum alloy wheels. The company has a complete industrial chain covering smelting equipment, wheel mold R&D and manufacturing, recycled aluminum resource recycling, recycled casting aluminum alloy R&D and manufacturing, functional intermediate alloy new material R&D and manufacturing, and automotive aluminum alloy wheels and lightweight chassis components design, R&D, and manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies including low-pressure casting, casting spinning, solid-state forging, liquid forging, and differential pressure casting for aluminum alloy wheel production. It has developed high-performance functional intermediate alloys such as grain refiners, metallographic modifiers, element additives, and metal purifiers. The company also focuses on R&D of integrated die-casting heat treatment-free alloys, brazable die-cast aluminum alloys, high thermal conductivity and electrical conductivity aluminum alloys, and low-carbon recycled aluminum alloys, supported by a strong patent portfolio and multiple national and international R&D platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global automotive manufacturers and retailers across North America, South America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. The company's products serve high-end manufacturing sectors such as automotive, aerospace, high-speed rail, electronics, power equipment, consumer electronics, industrial aluminum profiles, and packaging industries. The automotive segment includes OEM and aftermarket customers, with a focus on lightweight aluminum alloy wheels and chassis components for passenger and commercial vehicles, including new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales bases in China (Hebei, Tianjin, Shandong, Guangdong, Hubei, Jilin, Anhui, Chongqing), Thailand, Mexico, the United States, Brazil, South Korea, the United Kingdom, and Hong Kong. Its sales network covers China, Europe, North America, South America, Japan, Korea, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The company has established a global footprint to optimize resource allocation and serve international markets effectively.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lizhong Sitong operates across the midstream and downstream segments of the aluminum alloy supply chain. It engages in raw material recycling and smelting (midstream), alloy material R&D and manufacturing, and downstream automotive component manufacturing including aluminum alloy wheels and lightweight chassis parts. The company integrates upstream raw material supply with downstream product design, manufacturing, and sales, forming a vertically integrated industrial chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with strategic R&D in high-strength heat treatment-free aluminum alloys, brazable die-cast alloys, high conductivity materials, and low-carbon recycled aluminum. It invests heavily in new material development for emerging industries such as new energy vehicles, robotics, aerospace, and semiconductors. The company pursues green manufacturing, digital transformation, and global industrial chain integration, aiming to lead in lightweight, low-carbon, and sustainable aluminum alloy solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aluminum alloy products including functional intermediate alloys, recycled casting aluminum alloys, and aluminum alloy wheels. The company also earns processing fees for commissioned alloy casting services. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with automotive OEMs and retailers, with a focus on OEM supply and aftermarket distribution. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but emphasizes product sales and technical service support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lizhong Sitong is one of the largest and most comprehensive global suppliers in the functional intermediate alloy and recycled casting aluminum alloy industries, and a leading domestic producer of aluminum alloy wheels in China. It holds a strong market position supported by advanced technology, scale, and global production capacity. The company competes with other major aluminum alloy and automotive component manufacturers internationally, leveraging its integrated industrial chain and innovation capabilities to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately 27.25 billion RMB, representing a 16.61% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about 707 million RMB, with a net profit margin around 9.62%. The company has shown steady growth driven by increased sales volumes, product mix optimization, and global expansion. It maintains substantial assets totaling over 21 billion RMB and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lizhong Sitong emphasizes high-performance, low-cost, and low-carbon aluminum alloy materials with superior quality and stable performance. Its products meet stringent requirements for automotive lightweighting, aerospace-grade alloys, and recycled aluminum sustainability. The company differentiates itself through a vertically integrated supply chain, advanced manufacturing technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and global R&D collaborations. It also leads in green manufacturing and circular economy initiatives, providing customers with innovative, environmentally friendly, and cost-effective aluminum alloy solutions.
